description:
An e-commerce company has a comprehensive order fulfillment process:
When a customer places an order, the system records the order details.
Payment processing begins.
If the payment fails, the customer is notified, and the process ends.
Upon successful payment, the inventory system checks stock availability.
If items are out of stock, a back-order is initiated, and the customer is informed about the delay.
The process continues once the back-order is received and all required items are available in stock.
In-stock items are picked from the warehouse.
Quality control checks are performed on the picked items.
Packaging is done, including gift wrapping if the customer requested it.
Meanwhile, the shipping department prepares shipping documents and labels.
If the order is international, customs documentation is prepared.
Once packaging and shipping documents are ready, the order is dispatched.
The system sends a shipping confirmation to the customer.
After dispatch, the system updates the inventory levels.
A follow-up email for feedback is sent directly after confirming the successful delivery.
If the customer reports any issues upon delivery, a returns process is initiated, which includes:
Sending a return shipping label.
Receiving returned items.
Inspecting returned items.
Processing a refund or replacement.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentFailure" name="Payment failure notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BackorderDelay" name="Back-order delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FeedbackRequest" name="Feedback request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_IssueReport" name="Delivery issue report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReturnLabel" name="Return shipping label"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReturnedItems" name="Returned items"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="E-commerce company" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Start_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentFailure" name="Payment failure notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_PaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BackorderDelay" name="Back-order delay notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDelay" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_BackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackRequest" name="Feedback request" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackRequest" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FeedbackRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_IssueReport" name="Delivery issue report" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_IssueReport" messageRef="Message_IssueReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnLabel" name="Return shipping label" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ReturnLabel"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnedItems" name="Returned items" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" messageRef="Message_ReturnedItems"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer order initiation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerOrder" name="Customer begins placing an order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrder" name="Order placed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_CustomerOrder" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="End_CustomerOrder"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Order" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment" name="Payment successful?" default="Flow_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" name="Notify customer of payment failure" messageRef="Message_PaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failed"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock" name="All required items in stock?" default="Flow_OutOfStock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InitiateBackorder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyDelay" name="Inform customer of back-order delay" messageRef="Message_BackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveBackorder" name="Receive back-order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmAvailability" name="Confirm all required items are available in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Merge stock paths"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare items and shipping documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick in-stock items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QualityControl" name="Perform quality control checks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageItems" name="Package items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrapping requested?" default="Flow_NoGiftWrap"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift-wrap items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" name="Merge packaging paths"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International" name="International order?" default="Flow_NotInternational"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" name="Prepare customs documentation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomsMerge" name="Merge shipping document paths"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Packaging and shipping documents ready"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DispatchOrder" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostDispatchSplit" name="Complete post-dispatch activities"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm successful delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackRequest" name="Send follow-up email for feedback" messageRef="Message_FeedbackRequest"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostDispatchJoin" name="Post-dispatch activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fulfillment" name="Order fulfillment complete"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Returns" name="Process return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_IssueReport" name="Customer reports delivery issue" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_IssueReport" messageRef="Message_IssueReport"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label" messageRef="Message_ReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items" messageRef="Message_ReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectReturnedItems" name="Inspect returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement" name="Process refund or replacement"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Returns" name="Return processed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_1" sourceRef="Start_IssueReport" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_2" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_4" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_5" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement" targetRef="End_Returns"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_1" sourceRef="Start_Order" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_3" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentSuccess" name="Payment successful" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment" targetRef="Task_CheckStock">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failed" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentFailureEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="End_PaymentFailed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_4" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_Stock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="All required items in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allItemsInStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutOfStock" name="Items out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_1" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackorder" targetRef="Task_NotifyDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDelay" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBackorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBackorder" targetRef="Task_ConfirmAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_4" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockToPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Warehouse" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Shipping" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Warehouse_1" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityControl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Warehouse_2" sourceRef="Task_QualityControl" targetRef="Task_PackageItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToGiftDecision" sourceRef="Task_PackageItems" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrap"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrapYes" name="Gift wrapping requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrap" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${giftWrapRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGiftWrap" name="No gift wrapping" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrapToMerge" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingDocsToInternational" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_International"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternationalYes" name="International order" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalOrder}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInternational" name="Not international" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomsToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomsMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationToDispatch" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DispatchOrder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DispatchToPostDispatch" sourceRef="Task_DispatchOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PostDispatchSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostDispatch_Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_PostDispatchSplit" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostDispatch_Inventory" sourceRef="Gateway_PostDispatchSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToDelivery" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackRequest" targetRef="Gateway_PostDispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InventoryToJoin" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_PostDispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostDispatchToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_PostDispatchJoin" targetRef="End_Fulfillment"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
